slug: 2025-06-30 Signature of two MoUs between Niger and Libyan firm Al Itissal Al Jadeed - toward digitising passports and the national ID card

systems.system: Biometric e-passport issuance system with electronic archiving of records
systems.owner: Interior ministry, with the Libyan company Al Itissal Al Jadeed financing, building and maintaining it under a public-private partnership
systems.tiers: Memorandum of understanding signed 2025-06-27; chips meant to be read at airports, borders, police stations and security posts

systems.owner: Interior ministry, with Al Itissal Al Jadeed

note: Two memorandums on identity and travel documents; police stations appear only as places where a chip would be checked, and nothing is said of reports or cases recorded at a station.
